narrative: 垂直方向的图式很容易被忽视，直到它出错为止。意外过多的头部空间会让人显得下沉，这是一种典型的新手失误。
空间太少则会截断思绪。刻意留出的过量空间（一位修女身处一片苍白的墙面之下，一个男人身处采油井架之下）能让空白本身成为一个“搭档”。
总是把眼睛固定在三分线上来“修正”问题，这就不是对的工具。有些脸就是需要被天花板压制着，
有些则需要漂浮起来。三分法只是眼睛位置的默认规则，而不是顶部边缘的法则。
头部空间与服装和建筑相互对话。一顶高帽子、一盏光环般的灯、一道横梁：顶部边缘本身就是一个角色。
how: 从发际线量到画框顶端，而不是从眼睛量起。对于标准特写，留出适中的空间，足以让点头动作不被切掉。
如果要表现压迫感，就把空间压到几乎贴着头发。如果要表现天气或信仰感，就把脸放在画面下三分之一处，让天花板或天空占据其余空间。
俯仰运动和垂直升降可以在不换镜头的情况下改变头部空间。提示词：Deliberate headroom on [Subject], either tight to the hair (pressure) or generously open (air, God, sky).
when: 当房间是一个陷阱，或思绪没有天花板时，使用紧凑的头部空间。当土地、教堂或天空必须压过头骨的分量时，使用开阔的头部空间。
不要因为忘了向下摇而留出多余的天空。
vs: 前导空间（Lead Room）是运动方向上的水平空气。头部空间则是垂直方向的。
特写（Close-Up）这种景别会让头部空间的失误变得格外刺眼。负空间（Negative Space）常常寄居在过量的头部空间之中。
短边构图（Short Siding）在水平方向上压制视线。虚空背景（Void）可以吞噬掉一张脸上方的一切，直到没有天花板，只剩虚无。
examples_film: 经典好莱坞覆盖镜头保留适中的头部空间，以便点头动作不被切掉；《伊达》（Ida）用大片经过设计的墙面与天空作为上方的过剩空间，脸部则被安排得很低。
《血色将至》（There Will Be Blood）让采油井架和空气显得比头骨渺小得多。这是关于顶部边缘的语法，而不是一个裁切预设。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是意外的下沉感，因为操作员忘了向下摇，人物因此被“丢弃”在画面中。破绽是一片没有任何功能的剩余天花板，而眼睛离任何决定性的位置都相距甚远。
修正方法：为标准肖像向下摇一点，或者理直气壮地把这份过剩空间当作负空间来使用，刻意把脸安排得很低。

faq.q: 电影中的头部空间（Headroom）是什么？
faq.a: 它是头顶与画框顶端之间的空隙。空隙小：意味着压迫感。空隙大：意味着空气、建筑或天气占据了上方的空间。意外的大空隙是一种常见失误；刻意的大空隙则是一种构图。

faq.q: 头部空间（Headroom）与前导空间（Lead Room）有何区别？
faq.a: 头部空间是头骨上方的垂直空间。前导空间是行走或视线方向上的水平空间。你完全可以在同一个单人镜头中既有充裕的前导空间，又有紧凑的头部空间。它们是图式中不同的边界。

faq.q: 什么时候该用头部空间（Headroom）？
faq.a: 始终应该作为一个刻意的决定来使用。收紧它以营造压迫感，打开它以让天空或天花板发挥作用。不要因为忘了摇镜而留下多余的空气。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写头部空间（Headroom）的提示词？
faq.a: 说明是紧凑还是开阔，并指明上方区域的内容。示例：Deliberate headroom on [Subject], either tight to the hair (pressure) or generously open (air, God, sky)。AI模型默认会留出过多的天空，务必明确要求。

narrative: The vertical diagram is easy to ignore until it is wrong. Too much accidental headroom makes a person sink, a student error.
Too little clips thought. Deliberate surplus (a nun under a pale wall, a man under oil derricks) makes emptiness a partner.
It is the wrong tool to 'fix' by always parking the eyes on a thirds line. Some faces need to be crushed under a ceiling.
Some need to float. The rule of thirds is a default for the eyes, not a law for the top edge.
Headroom talks to costume and architecture. A tall hat, a halo lamp, a beam: the top edge is a character.
how: Measure from hair to the frame line, not from eyes. For a standard close-up, leave a modest band, enough that a nod will not clip.
For pressure, shave it to a hair. For weather or faith, drop the face in the lower third and let ceiling or sky own the rest.
Tilt and pedestal change headroom without changing lens. Prompt: Deliberate headroom on [Subject], either tight to the hair (pressure) or generously open (air, God, sky).
when: Use tight headroom when the room is a trap or the thought has no ceiling. Use open headroom when land, church, or sky must outweigh the skull.
Do not leave extra sky because you failed to tilt down.
vs: Lead Room is horizontal air in the direction of motion. Headroom is vertical.
Close-Up is a size that makes headroom mistakes loud. Negative Space often lives in surplus headroom.
Short Siding crushes the look horizontally. Void can eat everything above a face until there is no ceiling, only nothing.
examples_film: Classical coverage keeps modest headroom so a nod survives. Ida uses large upper fields of wall and sky as designed surplus, faces low in the diagram.
There Will Be Blood lets derricks and air dwarf a skull. Grammar of the top edge, not a crop preset.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is accidental sink, a figure dropped because the operator did not tilt. The tell is leftover ceiling with no job and eyes nowhere near a decision.
The fix is to tilt down for a standard portrait, or to own the surplus as Negative Space and compose the face low on purpose.

faq.a: It is the gap between the top of the head and the top of the frame. Small gap: pressure. Large gap: air, architecture, or weather owns the upper field. Accidental large gap is a common error. Deliberate large gap is a composition.

Headroom is vertical space above the skull. Lead room is horizontal space in the direction of a walk or a look. You can have generous lead room and tight headroom in the same single. They are different edges of the diagram.
Always, as a decision. Tighten it to press. Open it when sky or ceiling should act. Do not leave extra air because you missed the tilt.

faq.q: How do I prompt headroom for AI image or video?
faq.a: Say tight or generous and name the upper field. Example: Deliberate headroom on [Subject], either tight to the hair (pressure) or generously open (air, God, sky). Models default to too much sky. Be explicit.
